Está en Peñafiel (Valladolid), en la Rib: It is in Peñafiel (Valladolid), in the Ribera del Duero, about two hours from Madrid airport and about 45 minutes from Valladolid airport. Its restaurant Ambivium has one Michelin star and offers pairing with the house wines.

Está en Peralada, en el Empordà, entre l: It is in Peralada, in the Empordà, between the Pyrenees and the Mediterranean, a few kilometres from the Dalí Theatre-Museum in Figueres and the Cap de Creus natural park. The 50 Best listing places it about 41 minutes from Girona-Costa Brava airport.

Está en Laguardia, en la Rioja Alavesa y: It is in Laguardia, in Rioja Alavesa and at the foot of the Sierra de Cantabria, 1 h 15 min from Bilbao airport and 35 min from Logroño airport, according to 50 Best. El Puerto de Mahón es uno de los mayores: The Port of Mahón is one of the largest natural harbours in the Mediterranean, more than six kilometres long. It is a deep, sheltered inlet on the east coast of Menorca, and the town of Mahón looks down on it from the top of the cliff.

El Museo Guggenheim Bilbao es obra del a: The Guggenheim Museum Bilbao is the work of the architect Frank Gehry. It was built between October 1993 and October 1997 on a former industrial quay at a bend in the Nervión estuary, on a site that symbolised the reclaiming of the riverbanks for the city.
El exterior se reviste con unas 33.000 l: The exterior is clad in some 33,000 thin sheets of titanium. Gehry worked with CATIA, a programme born in the aerospace industry, to translate his design into a structure. The building has 24,000 m², 9,000 of them for exhibitions, spread over three levels around an atrium.
Junto a la entrada se alza Puppy, la esc: Beside the entrance stands Puppy, Jeff Koons's 1992 sculpture covered in flowering plants, which the museum acquired in 1997. Since then its collection has focused on works from the mid-20th century to the present and complements those of the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation.
El Museo del Prado abrió al público el 1: The Museo del Prado opened to the public on 19 November 1819. Its main building was designed by Juan de Villanueva in 1785, commissioned by Charles III, as the home of a natural history cabinet, as part of the redevelopment of the Salón del Prado next to the Botanical Garden.
Su base es la colección real de los Habs: Its foundation is the royal collection of the Habsburgs and the Bourbons. The museum holds the largest collections of Bosch, Titian, El Greco, Rubens, Velázquez and Goya. Among the best-known works are Las Meninas, Goya's two Majas and The Garden of Earthly Delights. The museum's own figures from 2021 speak of more than 8,000 paintings and more than 9,000 drawings in its holdings, of which only a part is on display.
Rafael Moneo diseñó entre 2001 y 2007 la: Rafael Moneo designed, between 2001 and 2007, the extension towards the cloister of the Jerónimos, without substantially altering Villanueva's building.
El Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina S: The Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía is Spain's national museum of 20th-century art. It was created in 1986 as an art centre and acquired the status of national museum in 1992. It is close to Atocha station.
El edificio central es un antiguo hospit: The central building is a former 18th-century hospital, the principal work of Francisco Sabatini. Jean Nouvel's extension, the result of an international competition in 1999, opened in October 2005.
La colección se centra en el arte españo: The collection focuses on Spanish art, with outstanding works by Pablo Picasso and Salvador Dalí, and a presence of Joan Miró. The best-known piece is Picasso's Guernica, painted in 1937 and exhibited in the museum since 1992, in the Sabatini building.
El Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza ocupa el pal: The Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza occupies the Villahermosa palace, on the Paseo del Prado. After passing through the hands of a bank, which gutted the interior in the 1970s, the building was offered to Baron Hans Heinrich Thyssen-Bornemisza after being considered as an extension of the Prado.
Rafael Moneo lo reformó entre 1989 y 199: Rafael Moneo refurbished it between 1989 and 1992. He preserved the palatial character of Antonio López Aguado's original design and turned the garden façade into the main entrance. The museum opened in October 1992 and the State bought the collection in 1993.
En 2004 se amplió con los palacios de Go: In 2004 it was extended with the Goyeneche and Guaqui palaces, designed by BOPBAA, to house the collection of Carmen Thyssen-Bornemisza. Since 2021 it has formed part of the Landscape of Light, inscribed by UNESCO.
El Museu Picasso abrió el 9 de marzo de: The Museu Picasso opened on 9 March 1963 in the Berenguer d'Aguilar palace, on Carrer de Montcada, under the name Sabartés Collection. Jaume Sabartés, Picasso's secretary and friend, had begun in 1955 the process of donating his collection to Barcelona, on condition that it be the seed of a future museum.
Con el tiempo el museo pasó de un edific: Over time the museum grew from one building to five, among them the Palau del Baró de Castellet (1970), the Palau Meca (1981) and the Casa Mauri and Palau Finestres (1999). The permanent exhibition occupies the first floor of four medieval palaces.
Picasso donó en 1968 los 58 óleos de la: In 1968 Picasso donated the 58 oil paintings of the Las Meninas series. In 1970 came another donation, with 236 paintings, 1,149 drawings and 17 sketchbooks. The museum also shows the artist's formative years, when he was educated in Barcelona between 1895 and 1904.
Madrid es una capital abierta y diversa,: Madrid is an open and diverse capital, with a historic quarter, family-run bars more than a century old and cultural centres that programme exhibitions and concerts. Its great museums are the Prado, the Reina Sofía and the Thyssen-Bornemisza. Luxury shops are concentrated on the Golden Mile. At the table, the tapas bars of La Latina sit alongside the avant-garde cuisine of restaurants such as DiverXO.
El aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Baraj: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas airport is about 12 km from the centre. Metro line 8 reaches all the terminals and the Cercanías C-1 and C-10 stop at T4 and connect with Atocha and Chamartín. High-speed trains to Barcelona, Seville and Málaga leave from Atocha; those to Valencia leave from Chamartín. Barcelona and Seville are from 2 h 30 away, according to Turespaña.
Barcelona es una ciudad cosmopolita, pun: Barcelona is a cosmopolitan city, a meeting point for trends in culture, fashion and gastronomy. It combines an unhurried old town with cutting-edge neighbourhoods. It offers traditional Catalan cuisine, internationally acclaimed haute cuisine and markets such as La Boqueria. Its Modernista architecture includes the Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló and La Pedrera. It faces the Mediterranean, with urban beaches, a seafront promenade, a marina and the Vila Olímpica.
El aeropuerto de El Prat está a unos 12: El Prat airport is about 12 km away. The centre can be reached in about 35 minutes or less by Aerobús, R2 Nord train, metro L9 Sud, bus or taxi. Sants station has high-speed connections to France, Madrid, Valencia, Málaga, Seville and Zaragoza; Madrid is reached in as little as 2 h 30. The port has services to the Balearic Islands.
La Costa del Sol, en la provincia de Mál: The Costa del Sol, in the province of Málaga, has its best-known hub in Marbella. The old town extends at the foot of the Sierra Blanca, with the Plaza de los Naranjos at its centre. Puerto Banús receives very large yachts every year and brings together restaurants and fashion brands. Golf is the other axis: Marbella has a dozen courses and the coast has more than 70, the highest number in continental Europe according to Turespaña. IAGTO named it Europe's best golf destination in 2025.
Turespaña habla de una media de 325 días: Turespaña speaks of an average of 325 days of sunshine a year. Málaga airport is about 8 km from the city; the Cercanías C1 runs as far as Fuengirola and there are intercity buses to Marbella, Estepona and Nerja. From Madrid, the high-speed train to Málaga takes from 2 h 40.
Palma, capital de Mallorca, se asienta e: Palma, the capital of Mallorca, sits on the bay that bears its name. Its old town brings together the cathedral, the Almudaina palace and the Lonja. Turespaña describes a mild climate all year round, with an average annual temperature of 17.9 °C. The island also has three train lines running through its interior.
El aeropuerto de Son Sant Joan está a un: Son Sant Joan airport is about 8 km from the city. There are direct flights to numerous European cities, of about two hours, and daily flights to the main Spanish cities. By sea, there are regular ferries to Barcelona, Valencia, Alicante and Dénia, and to the other Balearic Islands. In the city, the A1 bus serves the airport and the port, and the metro has two lines, M1 and M2.
Eivissa, la capital, es el centro cultur: Eivissa, the capital, is the cultural centre of the island. Dalt Vila, its walled enclosure, is entered through the Portal de Ses Taules and preserves white streets with boutiques, restaurants and galleries; at the top are the cathedral and the Almudaina. The island was declared a World Heritage Site for its biodiversity and culture, with the Puig des Molins necropolis as an example. Its beaches include d'en Bossa, Ses Figueretes and Talamanca. Formentera, with fine white-sand beaches, is about 30 km away.
El aeropuerto está a unos 7,5 km de Eivi: The airport is about 7.5 km from Eivissa and receives direct flights from the other islands, the mainland and Europe. By sea, there are ferries from Barcelona, Valencia, Dénia, Mallorca and Formentera to the ports of Eivissa and Sant Antoni.
Girona, la ciudad de los cuatro ríos, fu: Girona, the city of four rivers, was founded by the Romans in the 1st century BC and its historic centre preserves Roman, Arab and Hebrew traces. El Call, with Carrer de la Força as its axis, is one of the best-preserved Jewish quarters in Spain. The cuisine combines sea and mountain and is accompanied by wines from the DO Empordà-Costa Brava. The Costa Brava stretches from Portbou to Blanes and includes the Cap de Creus Natural Park, Cadaqués and Tossa de Mar.
El aeropuerto de Girona-Costa Brava tien: Girona-Costa Brava airport has a bus to Girona station, to Barcelona Nord and to El Prat airport; by road it is reached by the A-2, the AP-7 or the C-25. High-speed rail links Girona with Barcelona.
La DOCa Rioja se reparte en tres subzona: The DOCa Rioja is divided into three sub-zones: Rioja Alta, Rioja Alavesa and Rioja Oriental. Its Regulatory Council speaks of more than 66,000 hectares of vineyard and nearly 600 wineries with offerings for visitors. In February 2026 the denomination closed its centenary events and rated the 2025 harvest as excellent. The Rioja Alavesa, between the Ebro and the Sierra de Cantabria, has a microclimate favourable to Tempranillo and signature wineries such as Ysios (Calatrava), Marqués de Riscal (Gehry) and Baigorri.
Laguardia, capital de la Rioja Alavesa,: Laguardia, the capital of the Rioja Alavesa, is 18 km from Logroño and 45 km from Vitoria-Gasteiz. Vitoria and Bilbao have international airports. From Madrid, the region is about 362 km away along the A-1.
Valencia es una ciudad de contrastes, co: Valencia is a city of contrasts, with an old town close to futuristic buildings. The City of Arts and Sciences, the work of Santiago Calatrava and Félix Candela, includes the Oceanogràfic. Paella is the emblematic dish and Turespaña recommends trying it by the sea, on beaches such as Malvarrosa, El Saler or El Palmar. The Albufera is a navigable lake known for its sunsets. Turespaña cites more than 300 days of sunshine a year.
El aeropuerto está a unos 8 km, unos 20: The airport is about 8 km away, some 20 minutes on metro lines 3 and 5. Joaquín Sorolla station has high-speed services to Madrid, reached in as little as 1 h 50, as well as to Cuenca, Seville and Córdoba. The Fallas culminate every 19 March with the burning of the sculptures.
Cádiz se presenta como la ciudad más ant: Cádiz presents itself as the oldest city in western Europe, founded 3,000 years ago by the Phoenicians. Its historic quarters are El Pópulo, La Viña and Santa María, the heart of flamenco, and La Caleta is the old town's beach. Among its produce, Turespaña cites the prawns of Sanlúcar. Jerez provides the wine: fino, manzanilla and oloroso among the dry wines, and Moscatel and Pedro Ximénez among the sweet. Historic bodegas such as González Byass, with La Concha designed by Eiffel, or Domecq can be visited on the Marco de Jerez route, which includes El Puerto de Santa María and Sanlúcar. Jerez also has a programme of flamenco and horse culture.
Hay aeropuerto en Jerez, acceso por la A: There is an airport at Jerez, access via the A-4 from Seville and the A-7 from Málaga, and trains to Jerez, El Puerto de Santa María and Puerto Real.
La DO Ribera del Duero se creó oficialme: The DO Ribera del Duero was officially created on 21 July 1982. It spans four provinces, Soria, Burgos, Valladolid and Segovia, and 118 localities. According to its wine route, it has 23,353 hectares of vineyard (a 2021 figure), 73.45% of it in Burgos. Tempranillo, also called tinta fina, is the dominant variety; Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Malbec, Garnacha Tinta and, as the only white, Albillo Mayor are also authorised. The vineyard endures sharp temperature contrasts between day and night in summer.
La vendimia suele comenzar a finales de: The harvest usually begins in late September or, at the latest, early October, one of the latest in Castilla y León. Burgos has most of the vineyard, ahead of Valladolid, Soria and Segovia.
San Sebastián es una ciudad cosmopolita: San Sebastián is a cosmopolitan city with a strong Basque identity, with events such as the Tamborrada, the Semana Grande and the film and jazz festivals. It spreads along a bay between Mount Urgull and Mount Igeldo. Basque cuisine is internationally renowned and some of Spain's most celebrated restaurants are here; fish and seafood are accompanied by Getaria txakoli, which has its own denomination of origin. La Concha is a white-sand bay, with La Perla, a former royal spa, above the beach; Ondarreta begins at the Peine del Viento.
El aeropuerto de San Sebastián, en Honda: San Sebastián airport, in Hondarribia, is about 22 km from the city, reached via the N-638, the AP-1 and the AP-8, with buses between the two towns.
Sevilla es conocida por sus monumentos,: Seville is known for its monuments, its tapas, flamenco and its festivals. The Giralda, the cathedral and the Real Alcázar are very close together in the historic centre; Turespaña describes the cathedral as the largest Gothic church in Europe and notes that the Alcázar offers night-time visits in summer. The calendar is marked by the Feria de Abril, with guitar and flamenco, and Semana Santa, with processions and saetas.
El aeropuerto está a unos 10 km, junto a: The airport is about 10 km away, beside the A-4, and the taxi journey takes about 15 minutes. Santa Justa station, about 2 km from the cathedral, has high-speed services: Madrid is reached in about 2 h 40 min, Barcelona in about 5 h 40 min and Valencia from 4 h 30 min.
Bilbao combina arquitectura de vanguardi: Bilbao combines avant-garde architecture with an old town of streets and pintxo bars around the Plaza Nueva. The Guggenheim Museum, by Frank Gehry, is clad in 33,000 titanium panels and, together with New York and Venice, shares one of the most important private collections of modern and contemporary art in the world, according to Turespaña. At the Ribera market one can try pintxos and txakoli. Turespaña notes that the Basque Country is one of the places in the world with the most Michelin stars per inhabitant.
El aeropuerto está a unos 12 km del cent: The airport is about 12 km from the centre. The A3247 bus reaches Bilbao's intermodal terminal, with several stops in the city, and by the N-637 the journey by car takes about 15 minutes. Bilbao is also the gateway airport for the Rioja Alavesa.
Alicante, en la Costa Blanca, mantiene t: Alicante, on the Costa Blanca, maintains deep-rooted traditions such as the Moors and Christians festival and the night of San Juan, on 24 June, with bonfires of ninots. The Santa Bárbara castle, of Arab origin, dominates Mount Benacantil and its current structure is largely 16th-century. The Postiguet beach is next to the centre. Rice is the basis of local cuisine: a banda, black or baked. The wines carry the DO Alicante and Fondillón is its most distinctive sweet wine.
El aeropuerto Alicante-Elche Miguel Hern: Alicante-Elche Miguel Hernández airport is a few kilometres from the city and the C6 bus links with the Luceros tram station. From Madrid, the high-speed train reaches Alicante in as little as 2 h 15 min.
Turespaña describe en Tenerife un clima: Turespaña describes Tenerife as having a spring-like climate, with summer clothing all year round. Mount Teide, a National Park and World Heritage Site, can be climbed by cable car and allows an overnight stay at its foot, at the Parador de Las Cañadas del Teide; the park is also a good place for stargazing. In the south, Costa Adeje has a concentration of luxury hotels; in the north are Puerto de la Cruz and the Lagos Martiánez. The island's wines owe their character to volcanic soil and the Atlantic climate.
La isla tiene dos aeropuertos. Tenerife: The island has two airports. Tenerife Norte, about 3 km from La Laguna, handles most domestic and inter-island connections; Tenerife Sur handles international ones. A bus line links them in about 50 minutes.
